hook: The dark magic mushroom Galerina indica makes both psilocybin and deadly amatoxins, a first in one species.
summary: Mass spectrometry found psilocybin and amatoxins together in Galerina indica tissue, and genome analysis located the genes for both. Phylogenetic analysis suggests the psilocybin genes arrived by horizontal gene transfer after amatoxin production was already present. The timing is inferred from sequence trees, not observed directly.
title: The "dark magic mushroom" co-produces amatoxins and psilocybin.
